instagram_caption:
Michael Myers wore a Captain Kirk mask. 🎭

In 1978, John Carpenter was shooting Halloween on a budget of about $325,000. A custom mask was too expensive, so production designer Tommy Lee Wallace went to a magic shop on Hollywood Boulevard and bought a rubber Star Trek captain mask. The story goes it cost $1.98.

He widened the eye holes, removed the eyebrows and spray-painted the face a bluish white. The film was shot in South Pasadena, with dried leaves brought in to fake an Illinois autumn, and Carpenter wrote the score himself in about three days.

Halloween earned about $47 million. William Shatner says his first thought was whether it was a joke, and that he recognised it as the death mask made of his own face. He also says he went trick-or-treating in it.
